query:
SELECT u.id AS "user_id!",
               u.display_name AS "display_name!",
               u.email AS "email!",
               tm.role AS "role!",
               tm.joined_at AS "joined_at!"
        FROM team_members tm
        JOIN users u ON u.id = tm.user_id
        WHERE tm.team_id = $1
          AND tm.status = 'active'
        ORDER BY tm.joined_at
